status: Exploratory strengthening amendment; grids frozen before new outer performance is computed
real_data: Use the same 362 source-ground animal splits: 81 each core region and 200 prespecified RR-23 splits; no flight training or tuning
predictors: The same available inherited Sensor31 genes in every method; normalized held-out sensor expression is available, held-out outside-sensor outcome genes never enter scores or selection
outcomes: All outside-sensor genes surviving training-only mean-count >=10 filtering; log2(median-ratio normalized counts+1)
preprocessing: Canonical Ensembl genes, training-positive geometric-mean reference, per-column median-ratio factors, training-fitted intercept/age for predictors and outcomes; predictor scaling from training residual SD only; zero-variance predictor scaling set to one and documented
normalization_cache: LRU cache by dataset and sorted training animal set; cache contains training-derived gene filter/reference and separately computed per-column factors. Every column's factor uses only that column and the fixed training reference; cache cannot change training reference when held-out counts change
inner_selection: Leave-one-training-animal-out; refit filtering, normalization, nuisance means, sensor contrast, predictor scaling and all regression estimates in each fold. Select minimum summed outside-sensor SSE over all folds; all methods share identical fold targets and weighting
risk_CV_anchored_loading: gamma_lambda = w + lambda*(gamma_OLS-w), lambda=clip(sum inner response*prediction / sum inner prediction^2,0,1); no outer errors. Exact weighted sensor score removal, idempotence, sensor-orthogonal biology preservation; outside predictions equal ordinary scalar shrink at the same lambda. Inner fold omission range is sensitivity, not a calibrated uncertainty interval
ridge_objective: mean training squared prediction error plus alpha*coefficient squared norm in scaled sensor coordinates; alpha uses n_train*alpha in dual normal equations
PCR_definition: Principal component regression of training residual/scaled sensor predictors; components are learned only from sensor X
PLS2_definition: Established multivariate PLS regression with sequential covariance-maximizing X/Y deflation; training outside-sensor Y may inform training components, held-out Y does not; predictor scaling only, no outcome standardization
multi_sensor_correction: A=[0,0;-B,I] in sensor/outside ordering; subtract B*heldout_sensor_residual from outside outcomes and remove all individual available sensor coordinates. Spectral gain sqrt(1+||B||_2^2). For gain2 ridge clip every singular value of raw-unit B to sqrt(3); repeat clipping for every candidate inside CV
reporting: Keep all 9 methods, all splits, all CV candidates, failures and unavailable outputs; compare mean/median split MSE ratios and overlapping-split ranges, plus repeated-animal summaries. No split-independent CIs or post hoc superiority claims
verification: Reproduce prior original/cap2/scalar results, dense ridge/PCR formulas, PLS2 against sklearn PLSRegression on independent small matrices, training-reference perturbation checks, operator singular values and biology/sensor identities
simulation_track: Parent agent handles a separate known-truth NB-count correction benchmark with established methods; no duplicate favorable-only simulation here
interpretation: Within-resource inductive prediction and estimator stability; no proof of causal microgravity biology, universally correct nuisance removal, novel established algorithm, or guaranteed journal acceptance
